title: Fix explicit parent targeting for scheduled Issue Arborist links
body:
## Why

The scheduled [Issue Arborist run](https://github.com/github/gh-aw/actions/runs/38516088692) failed all 13 `link_sub_issue` outputs despite valid explicit parent references. The workflow omitted `target`, so the handler correctly used the default `triggering` target, which has no issue context on scheduled runs.

## Changes

Configure `link-sub-issue: target: "*"` so Issue Arborist can link children to existing parent issues or newly created parents referenced by temporary IDs. Regenerate the workflow lock and clarify the target contract in both synchronized tool schema copies.

Keep runtime authorization unchanged: omitted or explicit `triggering` targets still require an issue context, and invalid explicit parents remain rejected. Add regression coverage for scheduled, manual, and issue-triggered targeting, including numeric and temporary parent references.

## Validation

- All 31 focused sub-issue tests pass, including 16 new regression cases.
- `make fmt-cjs lint-cjs`, `make recompile`, and `make agent-report-progress` pass; generated workflow locks have no drift.
- Issue Arborist dry-run compilation passes strict validation, model checks, and shellcheck with zero warnings. Optional scanners were not run.
- Source security review found no vulnerabilities. The generated-lock follow-up with the same reviewer was unavailable because synchronous review agents cannot receive follow-up messages; that review remains outstanding.

No workflow dispatch or rerun was performed. Permissions, credentials, repository boundaries, and the 50-link limit are unchanged.
